$comment: External target apps (CT-03 skeleton): the only targets of ext.openApp and of installed detection (BR-ATTR-27 ①, 规划/03 §4.5). iOS LSApplicationQueriesSchemes (≤ 20 entries), Android <queries> packages and Harmony querySchemes are generated from this file. Nothing here is verified yet: values are candidates from 规划/09 CAP-TB-11, CAP-JD-11, CAP-PDD-11 and CAP-X-04 and stay status=candidate until the matching CAP item is verified; an empty list = not known yet. Clients never build jump URLs from these values: the server sends primary / fallbacks.
